items.title: Hamas confirms new armed wing chief killed in Gaza strike
items.description: Hamas's armed wing confirmed that its chief, Mohammed Odeh, was killed in an Israeli strike, after Israel had earlier announced his death. He had 'served as head of Hamas intelligence during the October 7 massacre,' Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said.

items.title: Ukraine: Russian attack destroys humanitarian food aid in Dnipro
